strings.d1.theme: The Strip: Bellagio to the Venetian
strings.d1.s0.name: Bellagio Conservatory
strings.d1.s0.tips: Free seasonal flower garden; look up in the lobby for the Chihuly glass ceiling.
strings.d1.s1.name: Bellagio Fountains
strings.d1.s1.tips: A free music-and-water show every 30 minutes, and every 15 minutes in the evening. It's the icon of the Strip.
strings.d1.s2.name: Bacchanal Buffet Caesars
strings.d1.s2.tips: Vegas's most famous buffet, with 250 dishes. Book ahead to skip the queue.
strings.d1.s3.name: Forum Shops Caesars
strings.d1.s3.tips: Roman-themed mall with a painted sky ceiling and the Atlantis show. Air-conditioned.
strings.d1.s4.name: Venetian Grand Canal Gondola
strings.d1.s4.tips: An indoor Venetian canal with gondoliers, next to a replica of St. Mark's Square.
strings.d1.b0.name: Eataly Park MGM
strings.d1.b0.tips: Italian food market; an alternative to the buffet.
strings.d1.b1.name: Wynn Lake of Dreams
strings.d1.b1.tips: The Wynn's lake show. Free, in the evening.
strings.d2.s0.name: Sphere Las Vegas Experience
strings.d2.s0.tips: The world's largest LED sphere. Postcard from Earth film (~100 USD); the exterior display is free at night.
strings.d2.s1.name: The LINQ High Roller
strings.d2.s1.tips: A 170 m observation wheel with air-conditioned cabins. Sunset rides are pricey.
strings.d2.s2.name: Fremont Street Experience
strings.d2.s2.tips: Downtown's covered LED canopy, with live music, the Golden Nugget and the SlotZilla zipline (~50 USD).
strings.d2.s3.name: Container Park Downtown
strings.d2.s3.tips: A shopping area built from shipping containers. The giant praying mantis sculpture shoots flames.
strings.d2.s4.name: Evel Pie Fremont
strings.d2.s4.tips: Punk rock pizza joint: slices and beer.
strings.d2.b0.name: Carson Kitchen Downtown
strings.d2.b1.name: Mob Museum
strings.d2.b1.tips: Museum of the Mafia; an alternative to Sphere.
strings.d3.s0.name: Red Rock Canyon Scenic Drive
strings.d3.s0.tips: 30 minutes from the city. A 21 km scenic loop that needs a timed reservation. It's cool in the morning and the rocks glow red.
strings.d3.s1.name: Calico Tanks Trail
strings.d3.s1.tips: A 4 km walk to a rock basin, with views of the Strip from above.
strings.d3.s2.name: Red Rock Casino Feast Buffet
strings.d3.s2.tips: A local buffet in Summerlin, cheaper than the Strip.
strings.d3.s3.name: Downtown Summerlin
strings.d3.s4.name: Cosmopolitan Chandelier Bar
strings.d3.s4.tips: A bar inside a three-storey chandelier. Try the Verbena cocktail.
strings.d3.b0.name: Spring Mountain Ranch
strings.d3.b0.tips: Ranch and lake at the foot of the canyon; an alternative to the hike.
strings.d3.b1.name: Lotus of Siam
strings.d3.b1.tips: Vegas's famous Northern Thai restaurant; an alternative to the buffet.
strings.d4.theme: Hoover Dam and Valley of Fire
strings.d4.s0.name: Hoover Dam
strings.d4.s0.tips: 45 minutes from the city. A 1936 dam with a Powerplant tour (15 USD) and a walk across the Mike O'Callaghan Bridge.
strings.d4.s1.name: Lake Mead Overlook
strings.d4.s1.tips: Viewpoint over the reservoir, where the water level shows a "bathtub ring".
strings.d4.s2.name: Boulder City Coffee Cup Cafe
strings.d4.s2.tips: 1950s-style cafe in the town that built the dam. Good for breakfast or lunch.
strings.d4.s3.name: Valley of Fire State Park
strings.d4.s3.tips: Red sandstone and petroglyphs. Hike to the Fire Wave, and in summer go in the morning (42°C).
strings.d4.b0.name: Seven Magic Mountains
strings.d4.b0.tips: Colourful stone towers in the desert by Ugo Rondinone, just off the I-15; an alternative to Valley of Fire.
strings.d4.b1.name: Boulder Dam Brewing
strings.d5.s0.name: Grand Canyon West Skywalk
strings.d5.s0.tips: 2.5 hours from the city (tour ~150 USD, or drive). The Hualapai tribe's glass bridge and Eagle Point. The South Rim is 5 hours away, too far.
strings.d5.s1.name: Hualapai Ranch Lunch
strings.d5.s1.tips: Lunch in the cowboy village at the Skywalk.
strings.d5.s2.name: Hoover Dam Bypass Viewpoint
strings.d5.s2.tips: Admire the bridge on the way back.
strings.d5.b0.name: Nacho Daddy Downtown
strings.d5.b0.tips: Nachos and scorpion shots Downtown; an alternative lunch.
strings.d5.b1.name: Grand Canyon Helicopter Tour
strings.d5.b1.tips: Helicopter flight over the canyon from Vegas (~400 USD); an alternative to driving.
strings.d6.s0.name: The Neon Museum
strings.d6.s0.tips: Old neon signs, visited on a guided tour. In winter, go during the day.
strings.d6.s1.name: Pinball Hall of Fame
strings.d6.s2.name: In-N-Out Burger Las Vegas
strings.d6.s2.tips: Behind the LINQ. Order it animal style.
strings.d6.s3.name: Cirque du Soleil O Bellagio
strings.d6.s3.tips: "O", the water-stage show at the Bellagio. Buy tickets online, or try TKTS (Tix4Tonight) for half-price same-day tickets.
strings.d6.s4.name: Bellagio Fountains at Night
strings.d6.s4.tips: Every 15 minutes at night; catch it after the show.
strings.d6.b0.name: Absinthe Caesars
strings.d6.b0.tips: Adult cabaret in a tent; an alternative to O.
strings.d6.b1.name: Hash House A Go Go
strings.d7.theme: Welcome sign and a gentle farewell
strings.d7.s0.name: Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas Sign
strings.d7.s0.tips: At the southern end of the Strip. No queue in the morning.
strings.d7.s1.name: The Park MGM & T-Mobile Arena
strings.d7.s1.tips: Pedestrian park and the Bliss Dance sculpture.
strings.d7.s2.name: Peppermill Restaurant
strings.d7.s2.tips: A 24-hour cafe with 1972 pink neon. Giant pancakes make a good farewell breakfast.
strings.d7.s3.name: Fashion Show Mall
strings.d7.s3.tips: Last-minute souvenirs; the airport is 15 minutes away.
strings.d7.b0.name: Bouchon Bakery Venetian
strings.d7.b1.name: Aria Fine Art Collection
strings.d7.b1.tips: Free art collection in the hotel; an alternative to the mall.
strings.note0: The Strip is 7 km long. A Deuce bus 24-hour pass costs 8 USD, there's also the monorail, and Uber costs 10-20 USD. You need a car for Red Rock, Hoover Dam and Valley of Fire.
strings.note1: October to April is ideal at 15-25°C, for desert hikes and the Grand Canyon day. Nights in December and January drop to 5°C, and New Year and CES are very crowded.
strings.note2: The resort fee (30-50 USD per night) isn't included in the hotel price. Buffets cost 60-80 USD and shows 100-150 USD; Tix4Tonight offers half price.
strings.note3: Drinks are free in casinos while you gamble. Tip 1-2 USD; in restaurants, 18-20%.
strings.note4: Book Sphere and O tickets weeks ahead. Red Rock scenic drive needs a timed reservation (October to May).
strings.note5: Grand Canyon West is 2.5 hours away (Skywalk) and the South Rim 4.5 hours; helicopter tours cost 400+ USD.
